0.0: Goodness, you have such a graceful, beautiful walk. You could be a model. Anyway, let me tell you about #bhunting#k...
0.1: #bHunting#k is the act of eliminating monsters. The more monsters you eliminate, the stronger you'll be! Some even drop presents after you smash them!
0.2: Try it out by pressing #b[Ctrl]#k to smack those #bJr. Sentinels#k to the right, er, left, I mean, right! Sorry, I get confused sometimes.

yes.0: Bring me #b1 Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece#k, too. I've always wanted to see one but still haven't quite figured out which end of my sword I'm supposed to hold.

no.0: I know I'm not as smart or as pretty or as cool or as brave or as strong as you, but I really, really want you to do my quest.

1.0: You're the strongest person I've ever met! Those monsters didn't stand chance, did they?

yes.0: To get stronger, you'll want to fight monsters #bnear your level#k, which means you'll have to hunt tougher monsters as you level up. By the way, let me know if you ever see any Lv. -10 monsters for ME to hunt...
